seo.description: Every organisation has the potential to become stronger. Greatstone helps organisations transform with confidence, strengthen organisational capability and invest in technology that matters.

props.headline: What We Believe
props.body: Strong organisations are built deliberately. They are built by leaders who understand what matters before deciding what must change, and who are willing to look honestly at how their organisation actually works rather than how it is described. That belief shapes how Greatstone engages. We begin with understanding rather than assumption, we let evidence rather than instinct guide what follows, and we measure success by the strength an organisation retains long after our involvement ends.
props.coda: This is not a methodology we apply to organisations. It is the standard we hold ourselves to.

props.heading: The Character of the Institution
props.intro: Organisations choose their partners carefully, and rightly so. These are the characteristics that shape how Greatstone works, and the ones our clients hold us to.

items.title: We look where others stop looking
items.text: The answer is usually in the part everyone had agreed to overlook. Examining it is uncomfortable and it is where the value is, so we go there first.

items.title: We build capability, not dependency
items.text: The measure of an engagement is what the organisation can do once it concludes. We are not a supplier to be managed. We are a foundation to be built upon.

items.title: We say things plainly
items.text: If a recommendation cannot be explained to the people who will live with it, the thinking behind it is not finished. Clarity is a discipline, not a style.

props.heading: The Greatstone Principles

items.title: Understanding Before Action
items.text: Every meaningful initiative begins with understanding. Before recommending change, Greatstone develops a clear understanding of the organisation, its objectives and the factors that will determine long-term success. Only then can meaningful progress begin.

items.title: Evidence Before Transformation
items.text: Transformation should always be guided by evidence rather than assumption. Every recommendation should be informed by organisational understanding, sound judgement and objective insight, creating the confidence required for meaningful and sustainable transformation.

items.title: Execution with Purpose
items.text: Every initiative should contribute to a clearly defined organisational objective. Transformation, specialist expertise and technology should never become objectives in themselves. They should always strengthen the organisation they exist to serve.

items.title: Capability That Endures
items.text: The measure of success is not the completion of an engagement. It is the capability the organisation retains, the confidence leadership gains and the strength the organisation continues to build long after the engagement has concluded.

props.headline: Cookie policy
props.body: Last updated 6 October 2026.
props.cueLabel: Scroll down to start the climb

props.body: We use a few small files and browser storage entries to make the site work, and, only if you say yes, analytics and preference cookies to see how the site is used and show you more of what you read. We do not use advertising cookies.
Cookies are small text files a website saves on your device. Sites can also save similar information in your browser’s local storage. This page covers both and calls them “cookies”.

The site needs these to work, so they do not ask for consent.
• gs-studio: holds a copy of the site’s pages in your browser, so pages load and show correctly. It holds site content only, nothing about you. Kept until you clear your browser storage.
• gs-consent: remembers your cookie choice, so we do not ask again. Kept until you clear your browser storage.
• gs_service_inquiry_v1: remembers the services you added to an enquiry. Kept until you send the enquiry or clear your browser storage.
• gs-studio-session: keeps Greatstone staff signed in to the site editor. Not set for visitors. Kept until the browser tab is closed.
• sb-…-auth-token: keeps you signed in, only if you sign in to an account. Kept until you sign out.

props.kicker: Analytics and preference cookies (only if you accept)
props.body:
These run only after you choose Accept analytics. They help us see which pages are useful and which campaigns bring people to the site, and remember what you looked at so the site can show you more of it. If you decline, or later change your mind in Cookie settings, we remove the ones we set.
• _ga (Google Analytics): tells one visitor from another, without identifying you. 2 years.
• _ga_… (Google Analytics): keeps track of a single visit. 2 years.
• gs-attr-first, gs-attr-last (Greatstone): remembers how you first and most recently reached the site (referring site, campaign tags, landing page), so an enquiry can tell us which campaign worked. Kept until you clear your browser storage.
• gs-intel-profile (Greatstone): on the AI Market Intelligence page, remembers which topics and vendors you read, so the “For you” feed shows related items. The profile stays in your browser. Kept until you clear your browser storage.
• gs_service_pop_v1 (Greatstone): on service pages, keeps a copy of which services are most viewed, so the “Popular” list loads quickly. Kept until you clear your browser storage.
• gs_service_pop_seen_v1 (Greatstone): on service pages, notes which services you viewed in this visit, so a page refresh is not counted twice. Kept until the browser tab is closed.

Google holds the analytics data for 14 months. Google’s own explanation is at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.

If you decline, Google may still receive basic signals with no cookies and no identifier, which it uses to estimate overall traffic.

Use Cookie settings in the footer at any time to accept or decline analytics. You can also delete cookies and site storage in your browser settings, or install Google’s opt-out add-on at tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.
